observations: Front cover of a PS4 game case.
Title 'SONIC FORCES' is clearly visible on the cover art.
ESRB rating 'E 10+' is visible in the bottom left corner.
Sega logo is visible in the bottom right corner.
The case is covered in a thin, wrinkled plastic wrap that does not appear to be a factory seal.
A watermark 'MOG GADGETS STORE' is overlaid across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Sonic Force is an interesting adventure game for kids
claims.evidence: The title on the box in photo 0 is 'Sonic Forces', not 'Sonic Force'.
This is a subjective opinion and cannot be verified through photos.

risks.risk: The game disc may be missing, heavily scratched, or replaced with a different disc.
risks.proof: A photo of the case opened showing the disc and a clear shot of the disc's data surface.
risks.if_unproven: as a missing or unplayable disc

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be a re-wrap hiding a used or damaged case.
risks.proof: A photo of the case without the plastic wrap, including the back and spine.
risks.if_unproven: as a used item in a damaged case

risks.risk: Region compatibility for DLC (ESRB rating suggests a North American region copy).
risks.proof: A photo of the spine or back of the case showing the CUSA region code.
risks.if_unproven: as the least desirable region for the Lagos market

proof_requests: Photo of the case opened showing the game disc.
Photo of the back of the game case.
Photo of the underside (shiny side) of the disc to check for scratches.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as Sonic Forces for PS4. It can be priced at its worst-case value (missing or damaged disc) until proof of condition and presence of the disc is provided.
